cohort: The study included 35 pregnant women with placenta previa (cases) and 138 pregnant women without placenta previa (controls).
finding: The prevalence of placenta previa was 0.57%, and advanced maternal age (OR 3.0; 95% CI 1.3-7.1) and previous cesarean section (OR 10.7; 95% CI 1.7-68.5) were identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was a significant risk factor for placenta previa (OR 10.7; 95% CI 1.7-68.5).
